VOLATILE PATHS: tools/facts never writes inside the repo. The ABSENCE arm creates its empty input fixtures via Python tempfile (OS temp dir) and deletes them before exit; the regression harness creates its scratch store via mktemp and removes it via trap. The claimlint ABSENCE surface's stderr names its temp input file verbatim — that path is the surface's own output, not a citation. Env knobs: FACTS_TEST_TIMEOUT_SECS (per-script cap for the TESTS section, default 300, 0=uncapped; a capped script reports exit=TIMEOUT(<secs>)) and FACTS_SECTIONS=ROWS,TREE,... (limits the run; the default prints the full fixed list). Full 88-script run on this host: 13m51s wall.

GATES/deviations: tools/regression-facts.sh is NOT wired into zig build test — the brief's two-files gate forbids modifying existing files (build.zig is one); wiring is a one-line follow-up mutation task, required by the standing tooling rule.
